title: Akbar Teri Yaad Ch Raat
body:
Akbar teri yaad ch raat dinay teri Sughra pae kurlaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Kisay bhain da veer na waang teray pardes ja wasaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Charh aaway saal atharwaan jad mass chehray tay leh pondi aay
Odi bhain nu veeran her wailay shagna di taang staandi aay
Shala banra na koi dunya tay haye khoon di mehndi laaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Laykhaa nu dosh dewa ki main mera baba aap likhari aay
Odi marzi nal vichora tay odi marzi naal beemari aay
Hasrat Shabir di deen uto ohda Akbar wareya jaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tu nazil hoya Laila tay seenay tay suwandi rahi Zainab
Haye Aun o Mohammad toun wadh kay teray laad ladandi rahi Zainab
Do maawa day ek bachray nu naal barchi maar mukaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tu fakhar e Yusuf aay Akbar main dhee Shabir sakhi di aa
Tu barchi nu seh Jana jay main dard vichora seh rahi aa
Menu das veeran hun bhain teri raway jeendi ya mar jaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akbar di laash nu khaimeyan wich shah kandd tay cha kay lay aaya
Tak seena zakhmi Akbar da phuphiyan nay vayn aay paya
Koi shakal Rasool nu ek waari ohdi Zahra naal milaway.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ek qabar Batool di baqiye wich dooji dhup tay roz banandi aay
Sughra her chaa nu hanjuwan da ro ro kay kafan pawandi aay
Koi bhain Samar na veeran day sehray tay neer wahaway.
